mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate level above 5.0% increases the risk-free discount rate for equity valuation models, reducing the present value of future cash flows and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and the signal is negative, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20d returns is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger central bank rate cuts, lowering discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when UNRATE rises above 4.5% within 3 months, or the Rank IC for UNRATE as a predictor of 5d returns is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint growth in industrial production (INDPRO) above 0.5% monthly and retail sales (RSAFS) above 1.0% monthly with stable inflation (CPIAUCSL growth < 0.3% monthly) indicates non-inflationary economic expansion that increases corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth > 0.5% and RSAFS growth > 1.0% and CPIAUCSL growth < 0.3%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when INDPRO growth > 0.5%, RSAFS growth > 1.0%, and CPIAUCSL growth < 0.3%, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle defined by FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL growth > 0.3% monthly increases discount rates and reduces liquidity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL growth > 0.3% monthly, or the Rank IC for the regime condition is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) above 112.0 (current level) indicates strengthening manufacturing output, increasing corporate revenue forecasts and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when INDPRO > 112.0 and the signal is positive, or the Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 20d returns is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1500.0 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand for durable goods, reducing economic activity forecasts and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when HOUST < 1500.0, or the Rank IC for HOUST as a predictor of 5d returns is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1) above 0.5% quarterly combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicates robust economic expansion with high consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 0.5% and UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Annual CPIAUCSL inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL annual change > 3.0%, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL as a predictor of 20d returns is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
